Each challenge carries a 128 bit nonce derived from the identity key and the epoch seed, so no two identities ever answer the same question. A bank of pre-written answers thus has nothing to key against, and filling 243 aliases means authoring 243 texts that each match their own nonce. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
